notes: This directory is the authoritative staged Linx ISA projection of PTO ISA 0.57.1.
PTO-ISA/pto-spec is the sole normative source for the 120 tile operations and 99 command forms; pto-spec.lock.json freezes its identity.
TEPL uses separate Mode and Function fields; the legacy TileOpcode and all legacy decode aliases are forbidden.
The exact tile inventory is 98 TEPL, 9 TMA, and 13 CUBE operations. Unlisted selectors and unassigned CUBE functions trap as illegal instructions.
TTRANSPOSE and TSORT32 are migration-only source aliases. Deleted D-class names have no architectural spelling or decode.
B.IOD remains reserved and old BSTART.PAR/TEPL encodings remain retired.
BSTART.TMA remains an encoding-family name, not a legal textual instruction.
